subject.title: North County Fire Protection District Board, Division 3

text: My wife, Anne, and I have lived in Fallbrook for 18 years. We have citrus and fig orchards and are supporters of Ag in the Classroom and FFA. I have a Master of Public Administration and am a graduate of CA Ag Leadership Program.

I’m a retired SD Co Agricultural Commissioner so I am familiar with balancing budgets, managing a diverse array of programs and negotiating the laws. Also, I served 3 years as the Malibu Zone Weed and Brush Abatement Inspector, so I have personal experience with Fire, and Health & Safety Care Codes.

The Rice Canyon fire burned across our farm, but fortunately, before we built our home. The second shock was when insurance costs increased 5-fold. Cal Fair Plan costs were still double the original. The insurance companies and banks won’t lose money, so we must find ways to reduce our losses and their monetary risk.

Working with the Fire Department and the insurers we can better protect our homes from devastating fires. Together we can incentivize fire safety and prevention and convince the insurers to reduce our rates.

text: Fallbrook and Rainbow are extraordinary communities, but we also face extraordinary wildfire risk. Protecting our families, homes, businesses, and firefighters requires thoughtful planning, fiscal responsibility, and leaders who prepare before disaster strikes. I am running for the North County Fire Protection District Board because our community needs leaders who plan ahead, ask tough questions, and make decisions based on facts.

I earned a degree in Earth and Environmental Science from UCLA, where I studied the natural systems that influence wildfire. My commitment to public service led me to the Davenport Institute’s Local Government and Community Program at Pepperdine University’s School of Public Policy. As a business owner with 18 years of community leadership and service, including serving on oversight boards for two voter-approved community college bond measures and leading nonprofit boards, I understand budgets, accountability, and delivering results.
As your representative, I will prioritize responsible budgeting, emergency preparedness, evacuation planning, and investments that keep our firefighters equipped and our residents safe.

I will bring scientific understanding of wildfire risk, practical business experience, and a proven record of leadership to prepare our fire district for the challenges ahead. I would be honored to earn your trust, your support, and your vote.
